Quick if you already have the items; collecting the items can take several days (the Mandrake is rare)

After saving the monkeys of Banuta, the shaman {npc:Hairycles} makes you his apprentice and gives you the **Shaman** outfit. Both addons are given by the shaman {npc:Chondur}, in Sabrehaven: the Voodoo Staff (with a Mandrake and 5 Voodoo Dolls) and the Voodoo Mask (with 5 Tribal Masks and 5 Banana Staffs). With everything complete you get the achievement **Way of the Shaman**.
If you have seen everything and used all the outfits, this outfit is the cherry on top. Maybe you can earn it by becoming the apprentice of a shaman... or of a voodoo priest.

Addons: access to Sabrehaven (you need the {wiki:Eleonore Quest}, part of the {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|Shattered Isles Quest}, so {npc:Captain Waverider} takes you with the password **peg leg**).
Voodoo Mask: you need to have the Voodoo Staff addon first.
only if you have not given them to Chondur yet (e.g. in the {wiki:Pirate Outfit} or to get past the energy barrier of Goroma); they drop from {creature:Novice of the Cult}
from {creature:Dworc Venomsniper|Dworc Venomsnipers} and {creature:Dworc Voodoomaster|Dworc Voodoomasters}
**Way of the Shaman** achievement (outfit with both addons)
Collect all the items **before** talking to Chondur: you save trips to Sabrehaven.
The {creature:Tiquanda's Revenge} is a rare {creature:Carniphila} boss that appears in Tiquanda; the {item:Mandrake} is the hardest item to get.

Take a boat to **Port Hope** (say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain, for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais). From Port Hope, cross the Tiquanda jungle **northeast** to {wiki:Banuta|Banuta}, the city of the apes in the north of the jungle. {npc:Hairycles} is in the temple in the **southeast** of the city, on the **first floor above the ground**.
Ask Hairycles for the shamanic powers
After finishing the {wiki:The Ape City Quest|Banuta Quest}, talk to {npc:Hairycles} in Banuta. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:shamanic powers} and {key:yes}. You receive the Shaman outfit.

Go down from the temple and return through the jungle to the **southwest**, the same way, to **Port Hope**. There {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities (including {key:liberty bay}, for the addons).

Before going to Chondur, collect: 1 {item:Mandrake} (from the boss {creature:Tiquanda's Revenge}, a Carniphila that appears in Tiquanda), 5 {item:Voodoo Doll|Voodoo Dolls} (from {creature:Dworc Voodoomaster|Dworc Voodoomasters}) and, if you have not given them to Chondur yet, 5 {item:Pirate Voodoo Doll|Pirate Voodoo Dolls} (from {creature:Novice of the Cult}).

Go to **Liberty Bay** (by boat: say {key:liberty bay} to a captain). On the small peninsula **southeast of the depot** talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes}. He takes you to **Sabrehaven**, on the island of Meriana, for 50 gp (only after the Meriana access mission of the {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|Shattered Isles Quest}). {npc:Chondur} lives **north** of Sabrehaven.
Hand in the Pirate Voodoo Dolls
Go to **Sabrehaven** and talk to {npc:Chondur}. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}: he asks for 5 Pirate Voodoo Dolls. Hand them over (one at a time).
If you have already given him 5 Pirate Voodoo Dolls before (for example to get past the energy barrier in Goroma), you **do not** need to give them again.
Say {key:task}, then {key:addon} and confirm with {key:yes}. He asks for a {item:Mandrake} and 5 {item:Voodoo Doll|Voodoo Dolls} from the dworcs.
Hand in the Mandrake and the Voodoo Dolls
With the items in your backpack say {key:hi}, {key:addon} (or {key:mandrake}, or {key:voodoo dolls}) and {key:yes}. You receive the Voodoo Staff addon.
To return to Liberty Bay, go **south** of Sabrehaven and talk to {npc:Sebastian}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp). Do the same after the next addon.
You can only do this addon after you have the Voodoo Staff.

Collect 5 {item:Tribal Mask|Tribal Masks} (from {creature:Dworc Venomsniper|Dworc Venomsnipers} and {creature:Dworc Voodoomaster|Dworc Voodoomasters}) and 5 {item:Banana Staff|Banana Staffs} (from {creature:Merlkin|Merlkins}, the ape mages of Banuta).

Return to Sabrehaven (with {npc:Captain Waverider} in Liberty Bay: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes}) and talk to {npc:Chondur}: {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:yes} (to hear the requirements) and {key:yes} again to accept.
Hand in the masks and the staffs
With the 10 items in your backpack say {key:tribal masks} and {key:yes}. You receive the Voodoo Mask addon and, with the full outfit, the **Way of the Shaman** achievement.
Voodoo Mask addon and Way of the Shaman achievement
At the end, return to Liberty Bay with {npc:Sebastian}, south of Sabrehaven: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
